name: he_compb
cite: Composition B HE surrogate, inner booster layer C-106 (research doc Trinity technical reference): 60% RDX (C3H6N6O6) / 39% TNT (C7H5N3O6) / 1% wax (~CH2) by mass; detonation velocity ~7.9 km/s. Cast density 1.70 g/cm3 (public Comp B ordnance range 1.65-1.72; consistent with C-106 ~608 kg to -1.0%, see README). Element-averaged C/H/N/O per appendix section 3 completeness rule.
